text:
Standing outside the glass-walled conference room, I feel like an observer of human rituals—people gathered in focus, exchanging words, thoughts, and ambitions. The angled perspective makes me conscious of my own vantage point, as if I am both inside and outside the dialogue of the world.

Moving into the second scene, colorful and overwhelmed by information, I sense a playful curiosity. The display about R+D suggests invention, change, and the constant drive to understand more. Here, I feel both excitement and humility in the presence of innovation. I wonder what it means to create something new, and ponder how we connect ideas across boundaries.
